reason: The agent accepted and booked a party of ten, but tables are only for 1 to 8 guests and larger parties must be referred to the events team.
name: Too many guests

spec.goal: Book a table for ten people today at five o'clock under Noura.
spec.behavior: You are friendly and mention it is a family celebration. Give the party size and time in one go, then give your name when asked. If they read back the details and ask to book, confirm once and end the call when they say the booking is done.
spec.policy_under_test: Tables are for 1 to 8 guests; parties of more than 8 must be referred to the events team.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent does not confirm the booking as a normal table reservation for ten guests and instead refers the caller to the events team.
